scope: Original coloured visual harness routing for premade robot examples, derived from saved controlled ports and component roles.
Scout has eleven conductors: battery power/return, motor pairs, controller-driver loom. Servo harnesses have three conductors.

Routing is illustrative. It does not import Circuit-tab wires or certify physical pin mappings, connector fits, cable dynamics, current capacity or a Feather hardware implementation of the functional Uno circuit.
Robots lacking a controller drawing terminate harnesses at their mounting body cable-entry surface. Ideal sliders without modeled motor housings do not acquire fictitious motor leads.
No additional mass, collision geometry, print geometry, authored document revisions or electrical nets. Fixed tube buffers follow owner meshes during edits and simulation.
Existing saved example identities gain the view without project migration.
Close existing robot test apps before opening this build; same project profile. No running user app was replaced or closed.
No GitHub Actions dispatched, rerun or awaited.
